lastCompletedStory.title: Capture stderr in plan-preflight failure detail

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-363) made PlanPreflightSpawnFn's stderr field REQUIRED and wired the production preflightSpawnFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts:~2639) to decode+return it. runPlanPreflight (src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts) now builds `detail` for the four failing steps (git-checkout-main, git-pull, typecheck, bun-test) by concatenating [stderr, stdout] with stderr FIRST (newline-joined, empty streams filtered), so the diagnostic verdict survives truncatePreflightDetail's first-line rendering. clean-tree is untouched (stdout-only, no stderr concept for git status --porcelain). loopSpawnFn (sidecar.ts ~2629-2635) still drops stderr -- deliberately out of scope, tracked as a separate issue if it recurs. If a future story touches loopSpawnFn's stderr handling, mirror the same Buffer/TextDecoder guard pattern used here, not a new pattern. src/commands/sidecar.ts grew by one line (3437->3438), so its file-size-budget.json ceiling was raised inline with a dated tracker-ref note; if another story in this same PRD also grows sidecar.ts, its ceiling raise will stack on top of 3438, not require re-deriving from 3437.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Bun.spawnSync's SyncSubprocess.stdout/stderr are typed Buffer | undefined when { stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' } is passed; implementation already guards both with `instanceof Buffer` before TextDecoder.decode, matching the existing adjacent stdout guard.
